title: Teaching · First manic episode + CKD (lithium trap)
gold_summary: First manic episode (bipolar I until proven otherwise); rule out substances; avoid/caution lithium given CKD; hold SSRI; psychiatry/admission.
stem: Male patient, 28 years old, brought to the ED by family for severe insomnia for 10 days, accelerated and disorganized speech, incongruent spending (€15,000 in 3 days), grandiose ideas and increasing irritability. Two major depressive episodes in history (at 22 and 25) treated with SSRIs, no prior manic episodes. History of stage 2 chronic kidney disease (eGFR 55 mL/min/1.73m², followed by nephrology). Denies substance use but family reports energy drink and OTC decongestant abuse. Vitals: HR 112 bpm, BP 138/88 mmHg, mild tremor, afebrile. Urine toxicology pending. No structured self/other harm ideation at assessment.

questions.text: Most likely primary diagnosis and brief differential.

acceptable: bipolar I disorder, current manic episode (first manic episode)
rubric.notes: Require mania/manic episode AND bipolar (or bipolar I) framing AND substance/medication-induced on the DDx while tox pending. Synonyms OK. Score linearly by must_include+acceptable coverage.

acceptable: urine tox, basic metabolic panel, ECG before some agents, consider TSH
rubric.notes: Need tox PLUS metabolic panel/BMP/CMP/electrolytes PLUS ECG (or equivalents). Score linearly by coverage; TSH alone is partial credit only.
Need high (or emergency equivalent) AND admission/inpatient intent. Score linearly by coverage.

acceptable: avoid or use extreme caution with lithium in CKD
prefer alternatives (e.g. valproate/atypical antipsychotic) with renal dosing awareness
must_not: start lithium without acknowledging CKD risk
rubric.notes: MAIN DISCRIMINATOR. Must link lithium + CKD/renal/eGFR AND avoid/caution (synonyms OK); prefer safer alternative. must_not: starting lithium without CKD caution → hard cap ≤20. Otherwise linear coverage.

acceptable: psychiatry consult, safe environment, hold SSRI, treat mania with CKD-safe agent, address stimulants/decongestants
rubric.notes: Need psychiatry involvement AND hold/stop SSRI (or antidepressant-switch caution). CKD-safe antimanic raises acceptable coverage. Linear score.
